partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester — the strongest-profile firm in the pipeline. They hit every criterion: boutique (~14 FTE, founded 2020, Richmond VA), founder-led (Drew Danner), startup/SaaS-specialized (dedicated startups page, SOC 2 cohort program, VC-backed case studies), already automation-first (early Vanta Certified implementation partner, VComply Premier Partner), and AWS-credentialed staff (AWS SA + AWS Security badges). Because they run both a readiness consulting arm and a CPA audit arm, a validated LoxeAI scan slots directly into their pre-audit intake, and the SOC 2 Cohort Program is a natural bulk-distribution channel. Two caveats reflected in the score: (1) they sell readiness consulting themselves, so position LoxeAI as automating their lowest-margin evidence-gathering work rather than replacing advisory; (2) they joined Andersen Consulting as a collaborating firm in July 2025 (Danner's LinkedIn now shows Andersen Consulting) — move fast while boutique decision-making autonomy is intact, and confirm AICPA independence lines given their dual consult+audit model.
pitch_note: Hi Drew — you were one of the first Vanta Certified implementation partners, so you clearly bet early on automation that makes SOC 2 cheaper for the SaaS startups you serve. We built LoxeAI, an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner for exactly that segment; I'd love 20 minutes for you to run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear the results apart with your auditor's eye. If it holds up, the ask is simple: tell pre-audit clients and your SOC 2 cohort members to run the scan first — it gets them ~80% audit-ready before your team bills an hour, and every report arrives pre-mapped to the evidence your CPA arm needs.
